provenance.limit: same look: on every frame where the glint plays its container reads the uninterrupted clock (visible_same_phase). No gain expected while away: the faithful arm already unmounts the animate pair whenever the ratio is below 0.35 (faithful_no_ticks_away), so the pause removes at most the ticks of the commit window between the observer report and the unmount (window_gain). Premises: the observer callback runs before the first frame that can show the glint (the glint needs ratio >= 0.35 plus a 1 s timer); the dash svg clock began before the first report (inline svg, INFERRED; setCurrentTime clamps at 0 and the model does not); setCurrentTime and getCurrentTime go through float32 seconds (error far below a frame, not modelled); the dash boxes lie inside the observed stage box
